local NULL = {}
local function fail(s)
    error(s, 0)
end
local function set(s)
    local a = {}
    for w in s:gmatch("%S+") do
        a[w] = true
    end
    return a
end
local reserved =
    set(
    "SELECT DISTINCT FROM AS JOIN INNER LEFT OUTER ON WHERE GROUP BY HAVING ORDER ASC DESC LIMIT OFFSET INSERT INTO VALUES UPDATE SET DELETE CREATE TABLE DROP PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL INT TEXT AND OR IS IN BETWEEN LIKE COUNT SUM MIN MAX AVG EXIT"
)
local aggregates = set("COUNT SUM MIN MAX AVG")
local comparisons = set("= <> != < <= > >=")
local function slice(a, first, last)
    local b = {}
    for i = first, last or #a do
        b[#b + 1] = a[i]
    end
    return b
end
local function concat(a, b)
    local z = {}
    for _, v in ipairs(a) do
        z[#z + 1] = v
    end
    for _, v in ipairs(b) do
        z[#z + 1] = v
    end
    return z
end
local function node(kind, op, args, value)
    return {kind = kind, op = op, args = args or {}, value = value}
end
local function tokenize(s)
    local a, i = {}, 1
    while i <= #s do
        local c = s:sub(i, i)
        local start = i
        local kind, value
        if c == " " or c == "\n" then
            i = i + 1
        elseif s:sub(i, i + 1) == "--" then
            i = s:find("\n", i, true) or #s + 1
        else
            if c == "'" then
                i = s:find("'", i + 1, true) + 1
                kind = "string"
                value = s:sub(start + 1, i - 2)
            elseif c:match("%d") then
                i = i + 1
                while i <= #s and s:sub(i, i):match("%d") do
                    i = i + 1
                end
                kind = "integer"
                value = tonumber(s:sub(start, i - 1))
            elseif c:match("[A-Za-z_]") then
                i = i + 1
                while i <= #s and s:sub(i, i):match("[A-Za-z0-9_]") do
                    i = i + 1
                end
                value = s:sub(start, i - 1)
                local upper = value:upper()
                kind = reserved[upper] and "keyword" or "name"
                if kind == "keyword" then
                    value = upper
                end
            else
                local two = s:sub(i, i + 1)
                if two == "<>" or two == "!=" or two == "<=" or two == ">=" or two == "||" then
                    value = two
                    i = i + 2
                elseif ("(),.;*/%+-=<>"):find(c, 1, true) then
                    value = c
                    i = i + 1
                else
                    fail("unexpected character '" .. c .. "'")
                end
                kind = "symbol"
            end
            a[#a + 1] = {kind = kind, value = value, text = s:sub(start, i - 1)}
        end
    end
    return a
end
local Parser = {}
Parser.__index = Parser
function Parser:new(tokens)
    return setmetatable({tokens = tokens, i = 1}, self)
end
function Parser:peek()
    return self.tokens[self.i]
end
function Parser:take()
    local t = self:peek()
    self.i = self.i + 1
    return t
end
function Parser:at(w)
    local t = self:peek()
    return (t.kind == "keyword" or t.kind == "symbol") and t.value == w
end
function Parser:accept(w)
    if self:at(w) then
        self.i = self.i + 1
        return true
    end
    return false
end
function Parser:syntax()
    fail("syntax error at '" .. self:peek().text .. "'")
end
function Parser:expect(w)
    if not self:accept(w) then
        self:syntax()
    end
end
function Parser:kind(k)
    if self:peek().kind ~= k then
        self:syntax()
    end
    return self:take().value
end
function Parser:comma(read)
    local a = {read()}
    while self:accept(",") do
        a[#a + 1] = read()
    end
    return a
end
function Parser:parens(read)
    self:expect("(")
    local a = self:comma(read)
    self:expect(")")
    return a
end
function Parser:alias()
    if self:accept("AS") then
        return self:kind("name")
    elseif self:peek().kind == "name" then
        return self:take().value
    end
end
function Parser:table()
    local name = self:kind("name")
    return {name = name, alias = self:alias() or name}
end
function Parser:reference()
    local name = self:kind("name")
    local e = node("ref")
    if self:accept(".") then
        e.table = name
        e.column = self:kind("name")
        e.text = name .. "." .. e.column
    else
        e.column = name
        e.text = name
    end
    return e
end
function Parser:expr(level)
    level = level or 0
    if level == 2 and self:accept("NOT") then
        return node("unary", "NOT", {self:expr(2)})
    end
    if level == 6 and self:accept("-") then
        return node("unary", "-", {self:expr(6)})
    end
    if level == 7 then
        return self:primary()
    end
    local left = self:expr(level + 1)
    if level == 3 then
        if self:peek().kind == "symbol" and comparisons[self:peek().value] then
            local op = self:take().value
            return node("binary", op, {left, self:expr(4)})
        end
        if self:accept("IS") then
            local neg = self:accept("NOT")
            self:expect("NULL")
            local e = node("isnull", "", {left})
            e.neg = neg
            return e
        end
        local neg = self:accept("NOT")
        local e
        if self:accept("IN") then
            e =
                node(
                "in",
                "",
                concat(
                    {left},
                    self:parens(
                        function()
                            return self:expr()
                        end
                    )
                )
            )
        elseif self:accept("BETWEEN") then
            local low = self:expr(4)
            self:expect("AND")
            e = node("between", "", {left, low, self:expr(4)})
        elseif self:accept("LIKE") then
            e = node("like", "", {left, self:expr(4)})
        elseif neg then
            self:syntax()
        end
        if e then
            e.neg = neg
            return e
        end
        return left
    end
    local ops =
        ({
        [0] = set("OR"),
        [1] = set("AND"),
        [2] = {},
        [4] = set("+ - ||"),
        [5] = set("* / %"),
        [6] = {}
    })[level]
    while ops[self:peek().value] and (self:peek().kind == "keyword" or self:peek().kind == "symbol") do
        local op = self:take().value
        left = node("binary", op, {left, self:expr(level + 1)})
    end
    return left
end
function Parser:primary()
    local t = self:peek()
    if t.kind == "integer" or t.kind == "string" then
        self:take()
        return node("literal", "", {}, t.value)
    end
    if self:accept("NULL") then
        return node("literal", "", {}, NULL)
    end
    if t.kind == "name" then
        return self:reference()
    end
    if aggregates[t.value] and t.kind == "keyword" then
        local name = self:take().value
        self:expect("(")
        local e = node("aggregate", name)
        if not (name == "COUNT" and self:accept("*")) then
            e.distinct = self:accept("DISTINCT")
            e.args = {self:expr()}
        end
        self:expect(")")
        return e
    end
    if self:accept("(") then
        local e = self:expr()
        self:expect(")")
        return node("group", "", {e})
    end
    self:syntax()
end
function Parser:clause(w)
    if self:accept(w) then
        return self:expr()
    end
end
function Parser:item()
    local start = self.i
    local e = self:expr()
    local tokens = slice(self.tokens, start, self.i - 1)
    local alias = self:alias()
    local heading = alias
    if not heading then
        if e.kind == "ref" then
            heading = e.column
        else
            heading = ""
            for i, t in ipairs(tokens) do
                if i > 1 and t.kind ~= "symbol" and tokens[i - 1].kind ~= "symbol" then
                    heading = heading .. " "
                end
                heading = heading .. t.text
            end
        end
    end
    return {expr = e, alias = alias, heading = heading}
end
function Parser:order_item()
    local start = self.i
    local e = self:expr()
    local single = self.i == start + 1
    local t = self.tokens[start]
    local desc = self:accept("DESC")
    if not desc then
        self:accept("ASC")
    end
    return {
        expr = e,
        desc = desc,
        ordinal = single and t.kind == "integer" and t.value or nil,
        alias = single and t.kind == "name" and t.value or nil
    }
end
function Parser:query()
    local q = {
        kind = "select",
        distinct = self:accept("DISTINCT"),
        joins = {},
        group = {},
        order = {}
    }
    if self:accept("*") then
        q.star = true
        q.items = {}
    else
        q.items =
            self:comma(
            function()
                return self:item()
            end
        )
    end
    self:expect("FROM")
    q.source = self:table()
    while self:at("JOIN") or self:at("INNER") or self:at("LEFT") do
        local left = self:accept("LEFT")
        if left then
            self:accept("OUTER")
        else
            self:accept("INNER")
        end
        self:expect("JOIN")
        local t = self:table()
        self:expect("ON")
        q.joins[#q.joins + 1] = {table = t, left = left, condition = self:expr()}
    end
    q.where = self:clause("WHERE")
    if self:accept("GROUP") then
        q.grouped = true
        self:expect("BY")
        q.group =
            self:comma(
            function()
                return self:reference()
            end
        )
    end
    q.having = self:clause("HAVING")
    if self:accept("ORDER") then
        self:expect("BY")
        q.order =
            self:comma(
            function()
                return self:order_item()
            end
        )
    end
    if self:accept("LIMIT") then
        q.limit = self:kind("integer")
        if self:accept("OFFSET") then
            q.offset = self:kind("integer")
        end
    end
    return q
end
function Parser:statement()
    local s
    if self:accept("CREATE") then
        self:expect("TABLE")
        local name = self:kind("name")
        local cols =
            self:parens(
            function()
                local c = {name = self:kind("name"), primary = 0, notnull = false}
                if not self:at("INT") and not self:at("TEXT") then
                    self:syntax()
                end
                c.type = self:take().value
                while true do
                    if self:accept("PRIMARY") then
                        self:expect("KEY")
                        c.primary = c.primary + 1
                        c.notnull = true
                    elseif self:accept("NOT") then
                        self:expect("NULL")
                        c.notnull = true
                    else
                        break
                    end
                end
                return c
            end
        )
        s = {kind = "create", name = name, columns = cols}
    elseif self:accept("DROP") then
        self:expect("TABLE")
        s = {kind = "drop", name = self:kind("name")}
    elseif self:accept("INSERT") then
        self:expect("INTO")
        local name = self:kind("name")
        local names
        if self:at("(") then
            names =
                self:parens(
                function()
                    return self:kind("name")
                end
            )
        end
        self:expect("VALUES")
        s = {
            kind = "insert",
            name = name,
            names = names,
            tuples = self:comma(
                function()
                    return self:parens(
                        function()
                            return self:expr()
                        end
                    )
                end
            )
        }
    elseif self:accept("UPDATE") then
        local name = self:kind("name")
        self:expect("SET")
        local assignments =
            self:comma(
            function()
                local n = self:kind("name")
                self:expect("=")
                return {n, self:expr()}
            end
        )
        s = {kind = "update", name = name, assignments = assignments, where = self:clause("WHERE")}
    elseif self:accept("DELETE") then
        self:expect("FROM")
        s = {kind = "delete", name = self:kind("name"), where = self:clause("WHERE")}
    elseif self:accept("SELECT") then
        s = self:query()
    elseif self:accept("EXIT") then
        s = {kind = "exit"}
    end
    self:expect(";")
    return s
end
local function column(t, name)
    for i, c in ipairs(t.columns) do
        if c.name == name then
            return i
        end
    end
end
local function resolve(e, scope)
    local found, kind, table_seen
    for _, entry in ipairs(scope) do
        if not e.table or e.table == entry.name then
            table_seen = true
            local i = column(entry.table, e.column)
            if i then
                if found then
                    fail("ambiguous column " .. e.column)
                end
                found = entry.offset + i
                kind = entry.table.columns[i].type
            end
        end
    end
    if e.table and not table_seen then
        fail("unknown table " .. e.table)
    end
    if not found then
        fail("unknown column " .. e.text)
    end
    e.index = found
    return kind
end
local function compatible(a, b)
    return a == b or a == "NULL" or b == "NULL"
end
local function require_type(a, b, op)
    if not compatible(a, b) then
        fail("type mismatch for " .. op)
    end
end
local check
check = function(e, scope, allow, grouped, inside)
    if e.kind == "literal" then
        return e.value == NULL and "NULL" or type(e.value) == "number" and "INT" or "TEXT"
    end
    if e.kind == "ref" then
        local t = resolve(e, scope)
        if grouped and not inside and not grouped[e.index] then
            fail("column " .. e.text .. " is not grouped")
        end
        return t
    end
    if e.kind == "aggregate" then
        if not allow or inside then
            fail("misuse of aggregate " .. e.op)
        end
        if #e.args == 0 then
            return "INT"
        end
        local t = check(e.args[1], scope, allow, grouped, true)
        if e.op == "SUM" or e.op == "AVG" then
            require_type(t, "INT", e.op)
        end
        return (e.op == "MIN" or e.op == "MAX") and t or "INT"
    end
    local ts = {}
    for _, arg in ipairs(e.args) do
        ts[#ts + 1] = check(arg, scope, allow, grouped, inside)
    end
    if e.kind == "group" then
        return ts[1]
    elseif e.kind == "isnull" then
        return "INT"
    elseif e.kind == "binary" and comparisons[e.op] then
        require_type(ts[1], ts[2], e.op)
        return "INT"
    elseif e.kind == "in" or e.kind == "between" then
        for i = 2, #ts do
            require_type(ts[i], ts[1], e.kind == "in" and "IN" or "BETWEEN")
        end
        return "INT"
    else
        local op = e.kind == "like" and "LIKE" or e.op
        local t = (op == "LIKE" or op == "||") and "TEXT" or "INT"
        for _, actual in ipairs(ts) do
            require_type(actual, t, op)
        end
        return op == "||" and "TEXT" or "INT"
    end
end
local function condition(e, scope, name, allow, grouped)
    if e then
        require_type(check(e, scope, allow, grouped), "INT", name)
    end
end
local function has_aggregate(e)
    if e.kind == "aggregate" then
        return true
    end
    for _, a in ipairs(e.args) do
        if has_aggregate(a) then
            return true
        end
    end
    return false
end
local function truth(v)
    return v ~= NULL and v ~= 0
end
local function inverse(v)
    if v == NULL then
        return NULL
    end
    return v == 0 and 1 or 0
end
local function quotient(a, b)
    local q = math.abs(a) // math.abs(b)
    if (a < 0) ~= (b < 0) then
        return -q
    end
    return q
end
local function operate(op, a, b)
    if op == "AND" then
        if a == 0 or b == 0 then
            return 0
        elseif a == NULL or b == NULL then
            return NULL
        else
            return 1
        end
    end
    if op == "OR" then
        if truth(a) or truth(b) then
            return 1
        elseif a == NULL or b == NULL then
            return NULL
        else
            return 0
        end
    end
    if a == NULL or b == NULL then
        return NULL
    end
    if op == "+" then
        return a + b
    elseif op == "||" then
        return a .. b
    elseif op == "-" then
        return a - b
    elseif op == "*" then
        return a * b
    elseif op == "/" then
        return b == 0 and NULL or quotient(a, b)
    elseif op == "%" then
        return b == 0 and NULL or a - b * quotient(a, b)
    end
    local ok =
        op == "=" and a == b or (op == "<>" or op == "!=") and a ~= b or op == "<" and a < b or
        op == ">" and a > b or
        op == "<=" and a <= b or
        op == ">=" and a >= b
    return ok and 1 or 0
end
local function like(text, pattern)
    local dp = {[0] = true}
    for i = 1, #text do
        dp[i] = false
    end
    for i = 1, #pattern do
        local c = pattern:sub(i, i)
        if c == "%" then
            for j = 1, #text do
                dp[j] = dp[j] or dp[j - 1]
            end
        else
            for j = #text, 1, -1 do
                dp[j] = dp[j - 1] and (c == "_" or c == text:sub(j, j))
            end
            dp[0] = false
        end
    end
    return dp[#text] and 1 or 0
end
local evaluate
evaluate = function(e, row, group)
    if e.kind == "literal" then
        return e.value
    elseif e.kind == "ref" then
        return row[e.index]
    end
    if e.kind == "aggregate" then
        if #e.args == 0 then
            return #group
        end
        local a = {}
        for _, r in ipairs(group) do
            local v = evaluate(e.args[1], r)
            if v ~= NULL then
                local duplicate = false
                if e.distinct then
                    for _, old in ipairs(a) do
                        if v == old then
                            duplicate = true
                            break
                        end
                    end
                end
                if not duplicate then
                    a[#a + 1] = v
                end
            end
        end
        if e.op == "COUNT" then
            return #a
        elseif #a == 0 then
            return NULL
        end
        local result = a[1]
        if e.op == "MIN" or e.op == "MAX" then
            for i = 2, #a do
                if e.op == "MIN" and a[i] < result or e.op == "MAX" and a[i] > result then
                    result = a[i]
                end
            end
            return result
        end
        result = 0
        for _, v in ipairs(a) do
            result = result + v
        end
        return e.op == "AVG" and quotient(result, #a) or result
    end
    local a = {}
    for _, arg in ipairs(e.args) do
        a[#a + 1] = evaluate(arg, row, group)
    end
    if e.kind == "group" then
        return a[1]
    elseif e.kind == "unary" then
        if e.op == "NOT" then
            return inverse(a[1])
        elseif a[1] == NULL then
            return NULL
        else
            return -a[1]
        end
    elseif e.kind == "binary" then
        return operate(e.op, a[1], a[2])
    elseif e.kind == "isnull" then
        return ((a[1] == NULL) ~= e.neg) and 1 or 0
    end
    local result
    if e.kind == "in" then
        result = 0
        if a[1] == NULL then
            result = NULL
        else
            local unknown = false
            for i = 2, #a do
                if a[i] == NULL then
                    unknown = true
                elseif a[i] == a[1] then
                    result = 1
                    break
                end
            end
            if result == 0 and unknown then
                result = NULL
            end
        end
    elseif e.kind == "between" then
        result = operate("AND", operate(">=", a[1], a[2]), operate("<=", a[1], a[3]))
    elseif e.kind == "like" then
        result = (a[1] == NULL or a[2] == NULL) and NULL or like(a[1], a[2])
    end
    return e.neg and inverse(result) or result
end
local function satisfies(e, row, group)
    return not e or truth(evaluate(e, row, group))
end
local function count(n)
    return n .. (n == 1 and " row" or " rows")
end
local function written(v)
    return v == NULL and "NULL" or type(v) == "number" and string.format("%d", v) or v
end
local function row_equal(a, b)
    if #a ~= #b then
        return false
    end
    for i = 1, #a do
        if a[i] ~= b[i] then
            return false
        end
    end
    return true
end
local function print_table(items, types, rows)
    local widths, cells = {}, {}
    for i, item in ipairs(items) do
        widths[i] = #item.heading
    end
    for _, row in ipairs(rows) do
        local r = {}
        for i, v in ipairs(row) do
            r[i] = written(v)
            widths[i] = math.max(widths[i], #r[i])
        end
        cells[#cells + 1] = r
    end
    local separator = "+"
    for _, w in ipairs(widths) do
        separator = separator .. string.rep("-", w + 2) .. "+"
    end
    local function render(cells, header)
        local s = "|"
        for i, c in ipairs(cells) do
            local padding = string.rep(" ", widths[i] - #c)
            s =
                s ..
                " " .. (not header and types[i] == "INT" and padding .. c or c .. padding) .. " |"
        end
        return s
    end
    print(separator)
    local heads = {}
    for _, item in ipairs(items) do
        heads[#heads + 1] = item.heading
    end
    print(render(heads, true))
    print(separator)
    for _, r in ipairs(cells) do
        print(render(r, false))
    end
    print(separator)
    print("(" .. count(#rows) .. ")")
end
local Database = {}
Database.__index = Database
function Database:table(n)
    if not self.tables[n] then
        fail("unknown table " .. n)
    end
    return self.tables[n]
end
function Database:targets(t, names)
    local a = {}
    local seen = {}
    for _, name in ipairs(names) do
        local i = column(t, name)
        if not i then
            fail("unknown column " .. name)
        end
        if seen[i] then
            fail("duplicate column " .. name)
        end
        seen[i] = true
        a[#a + 1] = i
    end
    return a
end
function Database:constraints(t, rows, checked)
    for _, i in ipairs(checked) do
        for j, c in ipairs(t.columns) do
            if c.notnull and rows[i][j] == NULL then
                fail("NULL value in column " .. c.name)
            end
        end
        if t.key then
            for j, r in ipairs(rows) do
                if i ~= j and r[t.key] == rows[i][t.key] then
                    fail("duplicate primary key " .. written(r[t.key]))
                end
            end
        end
    end
end
function Database:select(q)
    local scope = {}
    local width = 0
    local names = {}
    local function add(ref)
        local t = self:table(ref.name)
        if names[ref.alias] then
            fail("duplicate table name " .. ref.alias)
        end
        names[ref.alias] = true
        scope[#scope + 1] = {name = ref.alias, table = t, offset = width}
        width = width + #t.columns
    end
    add(q.source)
    for _, j in ipairs(q.joins) do
        add(j.table)
        condition(j.condition, scope, "ON")
    end
    condition(q.where, scope, "WHERE")
    local grouping = {}
    for _, ref in ipairs(q.group) do
        resolve(ref, scope)
        grouping[#grouping + 1] = ref.index
    end
    if q.star then
        for _, entry in ipairs(scope) do
            for _, c in ipairs(entry.table.columns) do
                local e = node("ref")
                e.table = entry.name
                e.column = c.name
                e.text = c.name
                q.items[#q.items + 1] = {expr = e, heading = c.name}
            end
        end
    end
    local aggregate = q.grouped or q.having ~= nil
    for _, i in ipairs(q.items) do
        aggregate = aggregate or has_aggregate(i.expr)
    end
    for _, i in ipairs(q.order) do
        aggregate = aggregate or has_aggregate(i.expr)
    end
    local grouped
    if aggregate then
        grouped = {}
        for _, i in ipairs(grouping) do
            grouped[i] = true
        end
    end
    local types = {}
    for _, i in ipairs(q.items) do
        types[#types + 1] = check(i.expr, scope, true, grouped)
    end
    condition(q.having, scope, "HAVING", true, grouped)
    local keys = {}
    for _, o in ipairs(q.order) do
        local key
        if o.ordinal then
            if o.ordinal < 1 or o.ordinal > #q.items then
                fail("ORDER BY position " .. o.ordinal .. " is out of range")
            end
            key = q.items[o.ordinal].expr
        elseif o.alias then
            for _, i in ipairs(q.items) do
                if i.alias == o.alias then
                    key = i.expr
                    break
                end
            end
        end
        if not key then
            check(o.expr, scope, true, grouped)
            key = o.expr
        end
        keys[#keys + 1] = key
    end
    local rows = scope[1].table.rows
    for ji, j in ipairs(q.joins) do
        local t = scope[ji + 1].table
        local nextrows = {}
        for _, left in ipairs(rows) do
            local found = false
            for _, right in ipairs(t.rows) do
                local combined = concat(left, right)
                if satisfies(j.condition, combined) then
                    nextrows[#nextrows + 1] = combined
                    found = true
                end
            end
            if j.left and not found then
                local padding = {}
                for _ = 1, #t.columns do
                    padding[#padding + 1] = NULL
                end
                nextrows[#nextrows + 1] = concat(left, padding)
            end
        end
        rows = nextrows
    end
    local filtered = {}
    for _, r in ipairs(rows) do
        if satisfies(q.where, r) then
            filtered[#filtered + 1] = r
        end
    end
    rows = filtered
    local groups = {}
    if not aggregate then
        for _, r in ipairs(rows) do
            groups[#groups + 1] = {r}
        end
    elseif not q.grouped then
        groups = {rows}
    else
        local groupkeys = {}
        for _, r in ipairs(rows) do
            local k = {}
            for _, i in ipairs(grouping) do
                k[#k + 1] = r[i]
            end
            local at
            for i, old in ipairs(groupkeys) do
                if row_equal(k, old) then
                    at = i
                    break
                end
            end
            if not at then
                at = #groups + 1
                groups[at] = {}
                groupkeys[at] = k
            end
            groups[at][#groups[at] + 1] = r
        end
    end
    local results = {}
    for _, g in ipairs(groups) do
        local row = g[1] or {}
        local context = aggregate and g or nil
        if satisfies(q.having, row, context) then
            local values, sortkeys = {}, {}
            for _, i in ipairs(q.items) do
                values[#values + 1] = evaluate(i.expr, row, context)
            end
            for _, key in ipairs(keys) do
                sortkeys[#sortkeys + 1] = evaluate(key, row, context)
            end
            results[#results + 1] = {values = values, keys = sortkeys, position = #results + 1}
        end
    end
    table.sort(
        results,
        function(a, b)
            for i, o in ipairs(q.order) do
                local x, y = a.keys[i], b.keys[i]
                if x ~= y then
                    local smaller = x == NULL or y ~= NULL and x < y
                    if o.desc then
                        return not smaller
                    else
                        return smaller
                    end
                end
            end
            return a.position < b.position
        end
    )
    local selected = {}
    local unique = {}
    for _, r in ipairs(results) do
        local duplicate = false
        if q.distinct then
            for _, old in ipairs(unique) do
                if row_equal(old, r.values) then
                    duplicate = true
                    break
                end
            end
        end
        if not duplicate then
            unique[#unique + 1] = r.values
        end
    end
    local start = (q.offset or 0) + 1
    local last = q.limit and start + q.limit - 1 or #unique
    for i = start, math.min(last, #unique) do
        selected[#selected + 1] = unique[i]
    end
    print_table(q.items, types, selected)
end
function Database:execute(s)
    if s.kind == "create" then
        if self.tables[s.name] then
            fail("table " .. s.name .. " already exists")
        end
        local seen = {}
        local primary = 0
        local key
        for i, c in ipairs(s.columns) do
            if seen[c.name] then
                fail("duplicate column " .. c.name)
            end
            seen[c.name] = true
            primary = primary + c.primary
            if primary >= 2 then
                fail("multiple primary keys")
            end
            if c.primary > 0 then
                key = i
            end
        end
        self.tables[s.name] = {name = s.name, columns = s.columns, key = key, rows = {}}
        print("Table " .. s.name .. " created.")
        return
    elseif s.kind == "select" then
        return self:select(s)
    end
    local t = self:table(s.name)
    if s.kind == "drop" then
        self.tables[s.name] = nil
        print("Table " .. s.name .. " dropped.")
        return
    end
    local rows, checked, countrows = {}, {}, 0
    if s.kind == "insert" then
        local targets = {}
        if s.names then
            targets = self:targets(t, s.names)
        else
            for i = 1, #t.columns do
                targets[i] = i
            end
        end
        for _, tuple in ipairs(s.tuples) do
            if #tuple ~= #targets then
                fail("expected " .. #targets .. " values, got " .. #tuple)
            end
            for i, e in ipairs(tuple) do
                local c = t.columns[targets[i]]
                require_type(check(e, {}), c.type, "column " .. c.name)
            end
        end
        rows = concat(t.rows, {})
        for _, tuple in ipairs(s.tuples) do
            local r = {}
            for i = 1, #t.columns do
                r[i] = NULL
            end
            for i, e in ipairs(tuple) do
                r[targets[i]] = evaluate(e, {})
            end
            rows[#rows + 1] = r
            checked[#checked + 1] = #rows
        end
        countrows = #s.tuples
        self:constraints(t, rows, checked)
    elseif s.kind == "update" then
        local names = {}
        for _, a in ipairs(s.assignments) do
            names[#names + 1] = a[1]
        end
        local targets = self:targets(t, names)
        local scope = {{name = t.name, table = t, offset = 0}}
        for i, a in ipairs(s.assignments) do
            local c = t.columns[targets[i]]
            require_type(check(a[2], scope), c.type, "column " .. c.name)
        end
        condition(s.where, scope, "WHERE")
        for i, r in ipairs(t.rows) do
            local nextrow = r
            if satisfies(s.where, r) then
                nextrow = concat(r, {})
                for j, a in ipairs(s.assignments) do
                    nextrow[targets[j]] = evaluate(a[2], r)
                end
                countrows = countrows + 1
                checked[#checked + 1] = i
            end
            rows[#rows + 1] = nextrow
        end
        self:constraints(t, rows, checked)
    else
        condition(s.where, {{name = t.name, table = t, offset = 0}}, "WHERE")
        for _, r in ipairs(t.rows) do
            if satisfies(s.where, r) then
                countrows = countrows + 1
            else
                rows[#rows + 1] = r
            end
        end
    end
    t.rows = rows
    print(
        count(countrows) ..
            (s.kind == "insert" and " inserted." or s.kind == "update" and " updated." or
                " deleted.")
    )
end
local source = io.read("*a")
local segments = {}
local start, i = 1, 1
while i <= #source do
    local c = source:sub(i, i)
    if c == "'" then
        i = source:find("'", i + 1, true) + 1
    elseif source:sub(i, i + 1) == "--" then
        i = source:find("\n", i, true) or #source + 1
    elseif c == ";" then
        segments[#segments + 1] = source:sub(start, i)
        start = i + 1
        i = i + 1
    else
        i = i + 1
    end
end
local db = setmetatable({tables = {}}, Database)
for _, s in ipairs(segments) do
    local ok, command =
        pcall(
        function()
            return Parser:new(tokenize(s)):statement()
        end
    )
    if not ok then
        print("ERROR: " .. command)
    elseif command then
        if command.kind == "exit" then
            break
        end
        local success, err =
            pcall(
            function()
                db:execute(command)
            end
        )
        if not success then
            print("ERROR: " .. err)
        end
    end
end
